title: Conversion report

fidelityHint.native-exact: Native Cognia plugin; no conversion required.
fidelityHint.structured: Declared contributions were converted. Review the per-capability limitations; native execution is not certified.
fidelityHint.contextual: Behaviour is rebuilt from what the source declared, not translated one-to-one.
fidelityHint.unsupported: This plugin cannot be converted without losing behaviour.

counts: {converted, plural, =0 {Nothing converted} =1 {1 capability converted} other {# capabilities converted}}, {warnings, plural, =0 {no warnings} =1 {1 warning} other {# warnings}}, {blocking, plural, =0 {nothing blocking} =1 {1 blocker} other {# blockers}}

native.ready: Native package can be written for independent installation.
native.review-required: Review the conversion changes and configuration requirements before writing the native package.
native.blocked: A complete native export is blocked by the issues above.

delivery.unverified: Native execution has not been verified against your installed agent version.

hosted.requires-cognia: Hosted tools: enable the plugin in Cognia and use it in a Cognia session with this agent. Cognia must remain running; tool permissions and availability are checked each turn.
hosted.unverified: Hosted use on this platform or cloud surface is unverified. A local Cognia endpoint must not be assumed reachable.

delivery.retained: Retained in Cognia: {capabilities}. These do not become native agent capabilities.
